name: Smithing table
description: SM1 weapon fitting bench (1.8 x 0.86 m, worktop 0.95 m, tool board to 1.9 m). E at it opens the fitting screen: fit or remove the Battle Royale attachments you carry on your guns (the same weapons and parts as Battle Royale). Battle Royale places a few in workshops, garages, barns and military buildings.
